title: Todd Monken dropped truth bomb about Myles Garrett before Rams trade became reality

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Todd Monken dropped truth bomb about Myles Garrett before Rams trade became reality
sources.description: The Los Angeles Rams may have completed the biggest trade of the NFL offseason, but comments from Cleveland Browns head coach Todd Monken suggest the groundwork for the deal was laid long before it became official.
